description: scenario-authenticator becomes an OIDC provider itself ("Login with Vrooli") and offers token introspection for opaque-token RPs.

requirements.description: scenario-authenticator must be capable of acting as an OIDC provider (issuing ID tokens, exposing /.well-known/openid-configuration, userinfo endpoint, and authorization code flow). This enables 'Login with Vrooli' scenarios where third-party applications delegate authentication to scenario-authenticator. Additionally, a token introspection endpoint (RFC 7662) must be available for relying parties using opaque tokens.
requirements.deferred_reason: OIDC provider mode and introspection are separate federation surfaces and are deliberately excluded from this delivery.
requirements.revisit_trigger: A relying party needs third-party sign-in through scenario-authenticator or opaque-token introspection.
requirements.title: OIDC Provider Mode and Token Introspection

validation.notes: api/internal/oidc/id_token_test.go: issue an OIDC ID token, verify it contains required OIDC claims (iss, sub, aud, iat, exp, nonce) and passes RS256 signature verification

api/handlers/oidc/oidc_e2e_test.go: GET /.well-known/openid-configuration returns valid discovery document; initiate authorization code flow with a test RP, complete sign-in, receive ID token and access token
api/handlers/oidc/introspection_e2e_test.go: call introspection endpoint with a valid opaque token → active=true with claims; with expired or revoked token → active=false

title: OIDC-Provider Mode + Token Introspection
